response.sql: WITH type_avg AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price FROM type_avg t, overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_price > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS m FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.avg_price FROM kept k, kept_mean km WHERE k.avg_price > km.m) SELECT AVG(f.avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(f.avg_price - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall_average, AVG(f.avg_price - km.m) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM final f, overall o, kept_mean km
